ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixel field estimated at 90-95% of total fluke area, with high-intensity white pixel clusters and linear formations occupying 5-10% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete white geometric blobs (circular rosettes) are scattered globally. High-contrast linear white streaks are clustered on the medial and distal regions of the right lobe, with a distinctive high-intensity cluster at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle; depth is partially occluded by the water line but vertex is clearly defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) are visible on the lateral thirds of both lobes, particularly near the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the lateral tips, characterized by irregular jagged interruptions to the smooth curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular rings (white outlines on black) corresponding to barnacle attachment points distributed across the lower-medial sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense collection of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions. Multiple intersecting diagonal streaks on the right lobe forming 'X' patterns and parallel vertical rake marks on the far right distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across the fluke surface; distal tips show high-intensity, irregular calcified clusters (possibly barnacles or heavy scar tissue), most prominent on the right-hand tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive high-contrast 'X' shaped white scar pattern located in the lower medial quadrant of the right lobe.
